description: Concurrent with the components written right (FT 0.5) before center (Sidman SSI 0.5, RSI 0.5); the keys are deliberately not in ascending order. At t=0.5 only the Sidman shock is due. From t=1.0 both components deliver on the same tick, and the first component in the order the spec lists them wins, so the FT's SR+ is the outcome, not the Sidman shock that would win if the keys were read in ascending order. Runners must keep the object's key order when they read this fixture.
name: concurrent-tick-tie-insertion-order
